findings.description: The upgrade command is written as `npx agentspine --yes --packs` with the packs described in prose after it. `--packs` takes one comma-separated value (src/cli.ts:80-85), so a literal form like `--packs ci-review,<other packs>` would show what to type. CHANGELOG.md:8-9 uses the same wording.

The Unreleased entry says only "re-scaffold with `--packs ci-review`". It leaves out the commit-first step, `--yes` and the "every other pack" caveat that the preamble, README and workflow comment all give.

process_issues.description: .claude-pr/ held only CLAUDE.md. The PR's copies of the RESTORE_PATHS entries (AGENTS.md, .agents, templates) were missing, so reviewers were told to read them with `git show HEAD:<path>`.

Spawned docs and conventions only. Skipped correctness, maintainability, security and context: the delta is prose plus one comment edit in the workflow template, with no logic, trust boundary or protocol surface changed. Skipped spec: no closing keyword or linked issue.
